Container.Name: eat
Container.Overview: Helps two people decide where to eat: nearby restaurants, mood filters, "Pick for us", favorites and meal history, Google Maps import, and suggestions from a local Ollama model.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app (SWAG proxies to this).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: eat.db (logins, favorites, meal history, restaurant list). Must be owned by nobody:users.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Address of the Ollama container, for the Ask page (use the server's LAN IP, not localhost).

Config.Name: GPU layers
Config.Description: Model layers forced onto the GPU (99 = all). Needed on the Intel Arc, same as the D&D Companion. Empty = let Ollama decide.

Config.Name: Google Places key
Config.Description: Optional. Empty = free OpenStreetMap search (no ratings or prices). With a key: Google ratings, prices and open-now.

Config.Name: Chat model
Config.Description: Ollama model that writes Ask answers.

Config.Name: Context size
Config.Description: Tokens of context for Ask answers.
